versions.changelog: Fix public display name formatting and sanitize documentation for official Hermes publication. Replaces lowercase title with proper display name and removes private domains from public docs.

AI Meeting Assistant for Jitsi Meet & Google Meet — initial release:

- Joins and records meetings via Habilis MCP Gateway (no local execution required)
- Real-time transcription with speaker diarization and duplex voice interaction
- Automatic generation of structured minutes (executive summary, decisions, action items, timeline)
- Supports both Jitsi Meet and Google Meet platforms with voice and chat features
- Secure design: API keys are never stored or transmitted outside the client's environment; transcripts are ephemeral
